name: errorlens-ai
description: AI-powered Error Explanation & Diagnostic Assistant with Vercel deployment support

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
